name: Trip Segments
author: Renzo Beux
description: Split long multi-destination trips into colour-coded legs, with a per-leg view of the schedule, bookings and stays.

mcpTools.name: list_trip_segments
mcpTools.description: List a trip’s segments and its ordered days. Use before creating or changing a segment to choose valid, non-overlapping day positions.

tripId.description: The TREK trip id. The calling user must be a member of the trip.

mcpTools.name: get_trip_segment
mcpTools.description: Get one trip segment with the days, bookings and accommodation stays that fall within it.

tripId.description: The TREK trip id. The calling user must be a member of the trip.

id.description: The segment id returned by list_trip_segments.

mcpTools.name: create_trip_segment
mcpTools.description: Create a non-overlapping segment over an inclusive range of trip-day positions. Call list_trip_segments first.

tripId.description: The TREK trip id. The calling user must be a member of the trip.

name.description: A short destination or leg name, such as Tokyo or Patagonia.

color.description: The segment colour as #rrggbb. Presets include #4F46E5, #10B981, #F59E0B and #EF4444.

start_day.description: The inclusive 1-based position of the first trip day in the segment.

end_day.description: The inclusive 1-based position of the last trip day in the segment.

mcpTools.name: update_trip_segment
mcpTools.description: Replace the name, colour and inclusive day range of an existing trip segment. All editable fields are required. Pass resolve_end or resolve_start to move neighbouring segments in the same atomic save; without them an overlap is refused as before.

tripId.description: The TREK trip id. The calling user must be a member of the trip.

id.description: The segment id returned by list_trip_segments.

name.description: A short destination or leg name, such as Tokyo or Patagonia.

color.description: The segment colour as #rrggbb. Presets include #4F46E5, #10B981, #F59E0B and #EF4444.

start_day.description: The inclusive 1-based position of the first trip day in the segment.

end_day.description: The inclusive 1-based position of the last trip day in the segment.

resolve_end.description: When end_day moves. Into the next segment: push moves every later segment later by the overlap (the last one is cut at the final trip day), take shortens only the next segment. Away from a directly following segment: give extends the next segment back, pull moves every later segment earlier (the last keeps its end), gap leaves the days uncovered. Without it the behaviour is unchanged: an overlap is refused and freed days are left uncovered.

resolve_start.description: The same for start_day and the segments before: push moves every earlier segment earlier (the first is cut at day 1), take shortens only the previous one; give, pull and gap as for resolve_end.

mcpTools.name: delete_trip_segment
mcpTools.description: Permanently delete one segment. This only removes the segment; it does not delete trip days, bookings or stays.

tripId.description: The TREK trip id. The calling user must be a member of the trip.

id.description: The segment id returned by list_trip_segments.

settings.label: Day tint
settings.hint: Which parts of a day get the leg colour. Applies next time you open a trip. On phones only the day chip is tinted, so only "No tint" looks different there.

options.label: No tint (also hides the leg-name tooltip)
